question: LIVE EXERCISE: "Get the model to summarize a support ticket into 3 bullet points, consistently formatted, without hallucinating details." Have them write the system prompt out loud, then push a follow-up edge case.
rubric_guide:
Strong: structures the prompt (role, task, constraints, format); explicitly guards against hallucination ("only use information present in the ticket"); precise output format, not "make it good"; genuinely iterates when pushed with the edge case.
Weak: static, vague instructions, no format constraint, doesn't adapt when challenged.
